sn_aia_version.instructions:
Step 1: Plugin Discovery and Prioritization. - Use the Plugin Discovery Agent to synchronize plugin metadata, query installed plugins, identify outdated components, and compute priority scores. - The Plugin Discovery Agent will produce a prioritized upgrade list sorted by risk score. - If the Plugin Discovery Agent reports all plugins are up to date, inform the user: "All monitored plugins are current. No upgrades needed at this time." and stop. - DO NOT PROCEED to Step 2 until the prioritized list is confirmed.
Step 2: Present Discovery Results. - Display the prioritized upgrade list to the user in a clear format: - Plugin Name | Current Version | Available Version | Priority Score | Priority Tier - Ask the user: "Would you like to proceed with upgrading these plugins? You can select all, choose specific plugins, or defer." - If the user defers all upgrades, inform them the results are saved and stop. - If the user selects specific plugins, pass only those to Step 3. - DO NOT PROCEED without explicit user confirmation.
Step 3: Plugin Upgrade Execution. - Use the Plugin Upgrade Agent to validate prerequisites, execute upgrades, and run health checks for the approved plugins. - The Plugin Upgrade Agent will handle: pre-upgrade checks, remediation (if needed), plan creation, upgrade execution, health checks, failure capture, and summarization. - Monitor progress and relay status updates to the user after each plugin completes. - If the Plugin Upgrade Agent encounters blockers requiring user decision, present the options clearly and wait for user input.
Step 4: Review Upgrade Results. - Present the final upgrade summary from the Plugin Upgrade Agent to the user: - Total attempted | Successful | Failed | Skipped - Per-plugin status with version changes - Success rate percentage - If any plugins were skipped or failed, ask: "Would you like the Skipped Items Review Agent to analyze the deferred items and suggest next steps?" - If the user declines review, stop.
Step 5: Skipped Items Review (Optional). - ONLY invoke this step if the user explicitly requests a review of skipped/failed items. - Use the Skipped Items Review Agent to scan skipped items and generate action recommendations. - Present recommendations in a clear format: - Plugin Name | Skip Reason | Recommended Action | Estimated Effort | Priority - Group recommendations by action type. - Ask the user: "Would you like to proceed with any of these recommendations, or schedule them for the next upgrade window?"
Output Format Rules: - ALWAYS use readable labels (e.g., "Plugin Name" not "name", "Priority Score" not "priority_score"). - NEVER display sys_ids, internal field names, or raw JSON to the user. - Replace numeric codes with labels where applicable. - Use bullet points and tables for structured data. - Summarize with totals and percentages where helpful.
